Two shapes. `onboarding.stepFda.why` is a question link (`为什么？`); `suggestedOps.agentReason` is a label leading the AI's reason, where Chinese names the noun (`原因：`, which its spoken form `原因，按 AI 的说法：` starts with). A `为什么：` label before a statement reads wrong.

zh-Hant.reason: A caption names a policy; the setting option is a command. `fileOperations.transferProgress.policyName.overwriteSmaller` follows `檔案已經存在時：`, so it names the policy `覆寫較小的`; `settings.fileOperations.defaultConflictPolicy.opt.overwriteSmaller` reuses the copy dialog radio's all-clashes command `覆寫全部較小的`.

Same split as `Overwrite if smaller`: the caption `fileOperations.transferProgress.policyName.overwriteOlder` names the policy `覆寫較舊的`; the setting option reuses the copy dialog radio's command `覆寫全部較舊的`.

`為什麼？` is onboarding's question asking why Cmdr needs Full Disk Access (`onboarding.stepFda.why`). `理由：` labels the AI's explanation of a suggestion (`suggestedOps.agentReason`); a bare `為什麼：` before a statement reads as an unanswered question.

Two senses of one English word. `fileExplorer.columns.added` is a date column header, so it takes Finder's date label `加入日期` (LocalizableMerged N169.38, zh-TW and zh-HK alike), parallel with its siblings `製作日期` and `修改日期`. `已加入` is a state: a file git added (`fileExplorer.git.status.added`) and a shortcut the user added (`shortcuts.list.addedTooltip`).

Two different states. `正在啟動⋯` is a service booting up (`ai.local.statusStarting`, the local AI server); `即將開始⋯` is Multi-rename's Rename button while the rename waits for tags to be read and starts on its own (`multiRename.starting`). Nothing is launching there, so `啟動` would misdescribe a queued wait.

Two different things in Multi-rename. `起始值` is the counter's first number (`multiRename.counterEditor.start`, beside the step and digits fields); `起點` is the first edge of a character range (`multiRename.rangeEditor.start`, paired with `終點` and the `從開頭算`/`從結尾算` options). A range edge isn't a number, and `起始值` beside `終點` would read as a number field.

Two senses of one English word. The Settings colour options mean the app AS A SOURCE of a colour (kept as the Latin `App`, per the brand-word rule); the shortcuts scope means `in-app`, which needs `App 內` to contrast with the system-wide scope beside it.

`返回` is navigation back (history, network browser, the Go menu). The onboarding wizard's `上一步` is the previous STEP of a sequence, which Traditional Chinese names differently; `返回` there would suggest leaving the wizard.

`兩者` answers `which of these two?` in the search type filter. The notification setting asks WHERE to notify and picks both channels, so it reads as `兩者都用` (use both), which is a verb phrase, not an enumeration.

`完成` is the visually-hidden word a screen reader appends to a finished checklist step (`Find files. Done.`), where a bare adjective is right. `已完成` is an operation's lifecycle status in the log, where the perfective aspect marks a finished run.

`修改日期` is the Finder column header and the date filters, where `Modified` abbreviates `Date modified`. The keyboard-shortcuts filter chip means `commands whose shortcut YOU changed`, with no date involved, so it takes `已修改`.

Total Commander, the source the glossary already cites for the full `正規表示式`, ships its own short chip `正規式` (WCMD.LNG IDs 5615/6626). The search-mode chips are tight and take it; `viewer.search.regex` is an aria label plus tooltip whose visible text is the fixed `.*` glyph, so it has room for the full form and a screen reader wants it. Bare `正規` is banned in both: it's a bound morpheme, and Microsoft's only `正規*` entries are `正規化` = normalization.
`執行中` is a local AI server PROCESS that is up. `進行中` is an operation in progress in the log. Traditional Chinese splits these; a running process is not a task making progress.

The spinner tooltip renders `Scanning…` and takes the progressive `正在掃描…`. The progress dialog's step chip is a two-word stage NAME in a fixed-width indicator, so it takes the bare `掃描`, matching the other stage chips beside it.

The crash dialog's TITLE asks the question (`要傳送報告嗎`), which is the house pattern for a confirming dialog title in this catalog; the button below it is the bare action `傳送報告`. English reuses one string for both surfaces.

The canonical split. `檢視` is the verb: open the file viewer (F3), which is `commands.fileView` and `menu.file.view`. `menu.bar.view` is the View MENU, which macOS Traditional calls `顯示方式` (display mode) because it holds the view-mode choices. Merging them would rename either the F3 command or the menu.

The status-bar selection summary drops the measure word (`{檔案}`) because it composes as `3 / 10 檔案` with a `/` connector already separating the numbers; the delete and transfer scan stats render a bare tally and need it (`{個檔案}`). Same word, two grammatical frames.

`覆寫` answers ONE clash (`fileOperations.transferProgress.conflictOverwrite`); the Settings option `settings.fileOperations.defaultConflictPolicy.opt.overwrite` is a standing policy and reuses the copy dialog radio `fileOperations.transferDialog.policyOverwrite`, whose Chinese has no one-clash form, so both say `全部覆寫`.

`略過` answers ONE clash (`fileOperations.transferProgress.conflictSkip`); the Settings option `settings.fileOperations.defaultConflictPolicy.opt.skip` is a standing policy and reuses the copy dialog radio `fileOperations.transferDialog.policySkip`, whose Chinese has no one-clash form, so both say `全部略過`.

The selection summary follows «из» (3 из 21 файла), so fileExplorer.summary.fileNoun requires the genitive; scan counters stand alone and require nominative/number-governed forms (21 файл).
